acceptance_criteria: Exactly 9 route poses x 61 z offsets = 549 candidates are audited with exactly 395280 horizontal and 1098 vertical rays.
Every candidate preserves horizontal/down/up distances, floor-following and feasibility decisions; every pose preserves all feasible intervals and nearest-zero recommendation if one exists.
Nearby route repeats are reported as physical groups without deleting or merging raw observations.
Inference, graph updates, training, C09/C10/M-TARE reads are zero; logs, metrics, candidate CSV, pose/group JSON, figures and seal are complete.
Audit PASS means diagnostic evidence completeness; all poses having feasible height is a reported result, not required for evidence PASS.
baseline: The frozen per-world FTA sensor height that produced 0.605--0.789m local horizontal clearance. Fallback: if any physical location has no feasible candidate, stop and recommend S10 mesh regeneration; do not delete frames or lower thresholds.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D only; expected seconds; zero GPU.

expected_evidence: 549-row candidate CSV, nine pose summaries and physical grouping JSON.
One plot per physical group with horizontal/down/up curves and frozen thresholds.
Aggregate and runner metrics, raw log, environment/tool/input hashes, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
method: At all nine sealed route failures, evaluate 61 sensor-z offsets from -1.00 to +2.00m at 0.05m spacing. A candidate is feasible only with horizontal clearance >=0.8m, nearest downward mesh hit 0.95--1.05m, nearest upward hit >=0.8m, and complete vertical evidence within 8m. Preserve all route repeats and group nearby physical locations only for reporting.
question: Can floor-following sensor-height adjustment make every localized S10 C08 low-clearance route pose satisfy the unchanged 0.8m horizontal and vertical safety contracts?
stop_conditions: Candidate/ray count mismatch, missing or nonfinite evidence, lost route failure or evidence seal failure.
Any topology/centerline/threshold change, trajectory write, inference, graph, training or C09/C10/M-TARE read.

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 to the exact recommended local pose feasibility audit and again during implementation.
